name: Marker
description: A divider that labels a moment inside a conversation or feed: a centered label between two lines. Use date for a new day, unread for where new messages start, and event for something that happened, like someone joining.

label.description: The text, e.g. "Today", "New messages" or "Alex joined".

variant.description: date is neutral. unread uses the action colour for the label and lines. event is a smaller, muted note.

dateTime.description: A machine readable date for a date marker, e.g. "2026-10-08". The label becomes a time element.

onJump.description: Turns the label of an unread marker into a button, e.g. to scroll to the first new message.

jumpLabel.description: Accessible name of the jump button when it needs more than the label, e.g. "Jump to first new message".

keyboard: Tab: moves to the jump button when onJump is given
requirements: Without onJump the marker is a separator named by its label, so the change of moment is announced once
With onJump the marker is a labelled group holding a real button, because a separator cannot contain controls
The lines are decorative and hidden from assistive technology
The unread variant also says its meaning in words ("New messages"), not only in colour
The label meets 4.5:1 on the background
screenReader: "New messages, button" when it can be jumped to

use_when: Starting a new day in a long conversation
Noting an event such as a person joining or a topic change
avoid_when: A plain line between unrelated content: use Separator
A section title that structures a page: use a heading
anti_patterns: A long sentence as the label: keep it to a few words
Using colour alone to mean unread
